messages.subject: HT-2025-000418 CMC - 21 May, directions
messages.plaintextBody:
Harriet,

CMC is listed for 21 May before HHJ Pemberton. Draft directions attached to the bundle: extended disclosure under PD57AD, single expert each, reports exchanged 30 Jan 2026, experts' meeting end Feb, witness statements end Nov, 6-day trial window opening 18 Jan 2027. The amendment to the Particulars should go through by consent. Anything you want changed before we file?

James
